title: Failure of Calderón-Zygmund estimates for degenerate elliptic PDEs with 𝐴_𝑝-weights when 𝑝>2

paper.title: Failure of Calderón-Zygmund estimates for degenerate elliptic PDEs with A p A_{p} -weights when p > 2 p>2
paper.abstract: Abstract. We use convex integration techniques to provide examples of failure of weighted Calderón-Zygmund estimates for degenerate linear elliptic PDEs when the weights are in A p A_{p} , p > 2 p>2 .

sections.text: We use standard notation, constants generally depend on the dimension, other relevant dependencies are indicated. Constants C C and c c may change from line to line. We write A ≲ B A\lesssim B if there exists a constant so that A ≤ C ​ B A\leq CB , and A ≈ B A\approx B if A ≲ B A\lesssim B and B ≲ A B\lesssim A .

sections.heading: Outline
sections.text: In Section 2 we present the proof of Theorem 1.3 in one dimension. In higher dimensions the argument is conceptionally the same, but we apply elementary splitting techniques from convex integration to ensure boundary data, see Section 3 .
